fields.why: Table 1 tests case status across five age groups with Fisher's exact test (p = 0.80), a test with the SPD as one margin.
Age is the only SPD with 3+ compared levels; race (Black non-Hispanic vs others) and sex are pairs.
Rules 2 and 6 make a Table-1 Fisher test on a 2 x 5 case-by-age table an omnibus test with n_groups 5, which A recorded.
